title: 『オペレーション：外出時トラブル』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Bourbon! I'd like to know more about you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I fail to understand your intentions. Why?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… well, I just thought that even though we share a dorm room, there's so much I don't know about you. It just feels a little weird…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So… If possible, I want you to take me to one of your favorite places!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I see. Reasoning understood. Request approved.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, traveling to a place I like will be somewhat arduous. Is that acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! I'll do my best to go anywhere you want!
I tag along with the two of them as their chaperone until we reach the mountain that Mihono Bourbon suggested.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can hear so many birds chirping… This place is wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Although it's rich in flora and fauna, it's incredibly well-maintained for hikers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is also a cafe at the summit that sells traditional desserts, which are well-suited for replenishing energy reserves after climbing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Wow, I can't wait!
After several hours of climbing, we reach a sign stating that the summit is only a hundred meters ahead. However…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I detect labored breathing from you, Flower. Are you feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm f-fine! Sorry, ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eeep!
Nishino Flower loses her balance and falls over!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Her anterior talofibular ligament seems to be twisted. Recovery will take several hours, during which she will be unable to continue climbing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-well, I'll just wait here, then! Please, go on ahead to the summit, you two!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Request rejected on account of associated risk.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, there is a chairlift nearby that can take us down the mountain. We should head there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But… we've come so far!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It would also be possible for me to carry you to the summit on my back.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Er, well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged. We will search for the chairlift. Let's go, Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… Not only did I ruin the climb, but now we're going to miss out on that dessert too…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Accessing data log.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is a popular Japanese-style dessert shop that opened one month ago at the foot of this mountain.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Their most popular item is the exquisite shiratama cream zenzai—a sweet red-bean soup with mochi, cream, and fruit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Shall we stop by, Master?
We soon find the newly opened shop at the foot of the mountain, just like Mihono Bourbon said.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mmm, so gooood… So fluffy, so chewy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Relaxing effects of high-quality sugar intake confirmed. A second visit will be taken into consideration.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: With you, of course, Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged. We will head to the summit. Get on my back, Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you… but I don't want to be any more of a burden!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No. The primary factor that lead to this predicament was my failure to notice your fatigue despite my extensive climbing experience.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In addition, your weight is within my load-bearing capacity. You will not be a "burden."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: B-but…
With Bourbon's gentle reassurance, the ever-hesitant Nishino Flower falls silent for a moment before nodding.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant.
We head for the summit and manage to arrive without any issues after thirty more minutes of hiking.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Amazing… What a beautiful blue sky!
Nishino Flower is entranced by the stunning view from the summit.
Then, on the way home…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even though I said I'd wait for you both, the truth is that I really wanted to go to the summit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thank you, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No thanks are necessary. The view really was spectacular today.
